questions.text: Where did you study nursing, was it a bachelor’s degree or a diploma, and what year did you finish?
How many years have you worked as a nurse, and was it paid work?
When did you last work as a nurse? Please say the month and the year.
Where do you live now, and are you allowed to work in Canada? Yes, no, or not sure are all fine answers.
Have you taken an English or French test? Which one, and when?
What have you already done for your nursing registration in Canada, and are any of your documents in a language other than English or French?
